subject: [PATCH 0/8] selftests/mm: add MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT contract tests

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed a potential false-positive in the test for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT range handling by verifying that the underlying folio was not split before checking if it is present.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided a fix for systems with >1024 CPUs by sizing the CPU mask to fit the number of CPUs, rather than using a fixed-size mask.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series adds selftests to cover the contractual behaviors of MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT, which share a page-table walker in mm/madvise.c. The tests are designed to ensure that userspace can rely on these behaviors across changes to the walker's implementation. The series includes 8 patches, each adding one group of tests, covering various aspects such as hole and swap checks, range handling, hugetlb VMAs, shared memory preservation, THPs, file permissions, and large file folios.
